headline: Airan Limited announces resignation of non-executive director Abhishek Sandeepkumar Agrawal
summary: Airan Limited has informed the stock exchange that Mr. Abhishek Sandeepkumar Agrawal is stepping down from his position as Non-Executive Director. The resignation will take effect from October 01, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance and board-level change for the listed company. Retail investors generally see minimal direct financial impact from standard non-executive director departures.
why_it_matters: Routine board changes have minimal impact on your shareholding.
